Interior · Bengaluru

Teresita

A Bengaluru restaurant and bar wrapped in bougainvillea, birdcage lights and painted portraits.

Location
Bengaluru
Venue
Restaurant & bar
Scope
Interior design
Spaces
Bar, verandah & dining rooms
The project

A garden that never stops flowering.

Teresita is soaked in colour: bougainvillea spills across the ceilings, birdcage chandeliers glow among the flowers, and painted portraits look down over the tables.

Warm timber, rattan and velvet keep it inviting, from the bar room to the open verandah and the quieter dining corners.

Inside Teresita

Space by space

The balcony

A statement red peacock chair and potted bougainvillea look out over the street.

The bar room

A backlit bar with murals and rattan seating anchors the main room beneath chandeliers.

The birdcage corner

An oversized birdcage light, flowers and a painted wall make one of the most photographed spots.

The mural booths

Green leather booths sit beneath hand-painted portraits and warm wall lights.
